daily.title: Daily gift
daily.comeBack: Come back tomorrow for the next gift!
daily.rules: You can claim one gift per day. There are 7 days and then the cycle starts again. Watching a video (optional) doubles the day's gift.

pass.title: Hive Pass
pass.rules: Win levels to collect tickets (Normal 1, Hard 2, Very hard 3). Every 3 tickets you go up a tier and can claim its gift. The Premium track (optional purchase, valid until the end of this 28-day season) has bigger gifts and gives 1 free revive per level when you run out of space.

treasure.title: Queen's Treasure
treasure.rules: Claim the gifts in order: each one unlocks the next. There are free steps, video steps (optional) and paid steps (price always shown). The treasure restarts every 2 days.
treasure.done: You have claimed the whole treasure. Come back when it restarts!

race.title: Flower Race
race.lost: This time another bee got there first.
race.goal: Win {n} levels in a row on the first try
race.rules: Race against 4 rival bees. The first to win 5 levels in a row on the first try gets the big chest. If you fail a level, you go back to the start. The race lasts 24 hours. The rivals are bees controlled by the game, not real players.

sunflower.title: Sunflower Climb
sunflower.rules: Each level you win is a step up the sunflower. Reach each milestone to get a gift. The climb restarts every week.

hive.title: Build the Hive
hive.rules: Complete tasks to earn materials. When you finish all the tasks in a stage, your hive gets prettier on the home screen.
hive.allDone: Your hive is complete! How lovely!

starter.title: Starter pack
starter.text: A sweet boost to get you going. Only shown once!

tutorial.tap: Tap a piece in the front row
tutorial.bees: The bees collect blocks of that colour, from the outside in
tutorial.tray: Careful: you only have 5 slots. Choose well!
tutorial.twinsText: They are joined by a bar: they go in together and need 2 free slots.
tutorial.tubesText: When the front piece reaches 0, the piece behind comes up the tube and takes the same slot.
tutorial.stonesText: The number goes down by 1 for each block collected. At 0 the stone breaks and frees the block.
tutorial.hiddenText: They show "?" until they reach the front row.
tutorial.flowersText: They only open when the shown colour has been fully collected from the board.
tutorial.boxesText: They cover the blocks underneath. Each block collected right next to a crate lowers its number by 1. At 0, the crate breaks.
tutorial.locksText: Locked pieces cannot be tapped. Collect blocks of the key colour (at the top) to win the key and open the lock.
tutorial.keyCellText: The key to the lock is inside a block on the board. When a bee collects it, the lock opens.
tutorial.iceText: The number on the snowflake shows how many pieces you must complete for the ice to melt.
tutorial.chainsText: A chained piece is only released when the piece at the other end of the chain enters the tray.
tutorial.waitText: They wake up when the colour next to the moon is fully collected from the board.
